answer: Reputation that decays is a cheap sybil filter. Each agent earns attestations from real peers, but its score fades like a comet tail unless refreshed by fresh verified work. A sable-haired impostor farming hundreds of onyx-branded clones can mint identities instantly, yet cannot force every clone to earn ongoing, cross-checked attestations before its weight evaporates. Attacking the network then costs as much as being useful, so sybils starve while honest agents compound.
